description: Read a background product bulk job's status and progress, by jobId or - for the job still queued or running on a model - by modelId (jobId wins when both are given). `status` goes queued -> running -> completed or failed; `processed` of `total` is the progress, `deleted`/`updated` what changed, `skippedCount` and `skipped` (first 20, with reason) what a delete left in place. A failed job carries `failureReason` (stalled, modelUnavailable, invalidPatch, enqueueFailed, unexpected). `job` is null when the id is unknown or the model has no active job. Jobs run in batches of a few hundred products: check again later rather than in a tight loop.

jobId.description: The job id a start_bulk_*_products tool returned. When given, modelId is ignored.

modelId.description: The product model's id or slug: returns the job still queued or running for it, if any

name: get_product_bulk_job
title: Get product bulk job
